Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Z User
Message:
feat(training+eval): Ryko v1.25.0 — argument-relations finally trained and measured as a treatment (3.33% -> 76.67%, pure-generalization zone 4/4) + comprehensive evaluation doc + independent verification session + audit fixes

The documented weakness #2 (COMPETITIVE.md §4: علاقة-حجاج شبه عشوائية —
never trained, 3.33% flat across v5c and the promoted point) is treated
with the project's own gate-closed proof-shard pattern (the v1.21.0 ling
precedent), measured on all four rulers, published with its interference
cost — and NOT promoted.

1. ARGREL PACK (src/ryko_lm/training/pack_argrel.py + CLI +
   tests/test_pack_argrel.py): deterministic builder deriving
   (claim, claim, relation) prompt/completion pairs from the committed
   argument_relations table (35 rows, v1.10.0 receipt) — 90 train pairs
   (8,041 tokens) / 15 val pairs (1,322 tokens), relation-level 30/5
   split (no phrasing of one relation crosses splits), sha256 manifests,
   FATAL leakage check, pack_sft-contract uint16 streams, verified
   receipt (train b8c59904 / val 69b104a0).

2. PROOF SHARD (artifacts/proof_argrel_small/, receipt 7473ceb6):
   warm start from the serving point dpo_round2_small (f0361c4a), 90
   steps (~22.9 epochs of the narrow pack), lr 2e-5 -> 2e-6 cosine,
   batch 1 x grad_accum 4, block 512, seed 1337, 5.4 min on 2 CPU cores;
   val_loss 5.08 -> 4.55 (best), train_loss 4.68 -> 3.38; final.pt +
   summary + log committed, resumable state (last.pt/best.pt) gitignored.

3. MEASURED ON ALL FOUR RULERS (identical protocol, threshold 0.65,
   deterministic runners): RYKO-Bench seed MCQ 39.62 -> 55.35% (+15.73)
   with argument-relations 3.33 -> 76.67%; RYKO-1000 base MCQ 33.71 ->
   44.60% (+10.89) with over-refusal 0.5938 -> 0.4062 (the argrel pack
   partially treated the ling-merge cost) and correct-abstain 1.00 held
   everywhere; cite 1.0 with the identical 72/28 verdict distribution;
   rb-ling 44.23 -> 30.77% (the documented narrow-pack interference
   cost, -13.46); PalmX-IC 29.05 -> 28.24% (-0.81 external). Reports:
   docs/results/argrel_proof{,_ling,_ryko1000,_palmx}.{json,md}.

4. MEMORIZATION vs GENERALIZATION (scripts/argrel_overlap_analysis.py,
   per relation_id): the pack derives from the same table the rb-rel
   family tests from, so the two components are separated — train-zone
   (26 cases) 73.08% (NOT blind memorization), held-out-relation zone
   (4 cases) 100% — the model learned the relation-verification task,
   not the rows. Honest reading published with the n=4 caveat.

5. DECISION — NO PROMOTION: the shard stays a proof artifact; the
   serving point remains dpo_round2_small (pinned by the v1.24.0 test).
   The no-regression gate forbids promoting a point that costs rb-ling
   -13.46. Documented next round: a COMBINED pack (argrel + ling +
   weakest RYKO-1000 families) or wide GPU pretraining per §6 — plan in
   docs/EVALUATION.md v1.26.0/v1.27.0.

6. COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION DOC (docs/EVALUATION.md): the unified
   standing ledger requested by the project review — measured numbers on
   the served point and the proof shard, the independent verification
   session results, ten ranked weaknesses with CPU/GPU/DATA/INFRA
   classification, the honest competitive standing (no head-to-head
   accuracy comparison exists with any competitor; PalmX-IC 29.05% is
   the only same-benchmark instrument), and the release-by-release plan
   v1.26.0 -> v1.28.0. Live successor to the frozen v1.17.0 COMPETITIVE
   doc (which now carries a v1.24/v1.25 status banner; history kept).

7. INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION SESSION (on the v1.24.0 tree, before this
   release): 237 collected = 236 passed + 1 documented fresh-clone skip;
   secret_scan clean; dual-build determinism byte-identical (b4d1ffee);
   all three frozen seed contracts reproduce their pins byte-exactly
   (bench prefix 277 / ryko1000 prefix 1,000 / ling probes 52);
   17 receipts = ZERO hash drift, ZERO tampering (6 expected fresh-clone
   misses on gitignored rebuildables); committed store byte-immutable
   across all measurements; ZERO referenced-but-missing result file
   across CHANGELOG v1.15->v1.24.

8. AUDIT FIXES: README.md (English) still pointed quick-start at v5c
   after the v1.24.0 promotion — updated with the promotion story
   (mirrors README_AR); data/bench/palmx_ic.receipt.json is a dataset
   manifest, not a ZYKO receipt — renamed palmx_ic.manifest.json and
   references updated (historical CHANGELOG line kept verbatim);
   README_AR knowledge-core counts refreshed to the committed state
   (70 passage-bearing books / 93,359 passages / 159-book catalog);
   split_manifest.json gained a frozen_prefix_note documenting that
   6dd14326 pins the first 1,000 lines (pre-v1.22.0 state);
   test_ling_probes_seed_byte_frozen pins ling_probes.jsonl's full
   sha256 (a48ec0a2) that was only prose-documented; three lineage
   checkpoints receipted retroactively with params counted from their
   own bytes (training/final.pt 11.54M, training_v5/final.pt 11.54M,
   training_small_ling_sftdpo/final.pt 52.18M — the v1.22.0 merged
   point and init_from of the promoted checkpoint); .gitignore rules
   for the shard's resumable state.

9. Tests: 243 collected (237 prior + 5 pack_argrel + 1 ling-probes
   pin), zero failures; secret_scan clean (scanned=344 critical=0).
   The 7/7 data gates closed at v1.22.0 carry over unchanged — no
   dataset or gate-relevant artifact was touched (append-only contract
   intact; the seeds and RYKO-1000 are byte-frozen).

The release in one line: the flagship differentiator (documented
argument-relations) is converted from stored scaffolding into measured
capability — +73.34 on its family with a 4/4 pure-generalization zone —
at a documented interference cost that the no-promotion gate converts
into the v1.26.0 combined-pack plan instead of a silent serving change.

Message: feat(training): Ryko v1.20.0 — phases 5 + 9 EXECUTED and measured without GPU: (1) new DPO trainer (src/ryko_lm/training/dpo_train.py + CLI + tests): full DPO with train.py discipline — exact resume (model+optimizer+step), frozen reference = a copy of the SFT init itself, graceful time-budget stop, JSONL metrics log, final preference-accuracy summary; loss = -log sigmoid(beta*((s_chosen-s_chosen_ref)-(s_rejected-s_rejected_ref))) with per-row padded masks (equivalence test vs single-row logprob), warm-start tie handling for the saved-fp16 contract; (2) SFT packer (src/ryko_lm/training/pack_sft.py + CLI + tests): deterministic uint16 stream encode(prompt)+encode(completion)+[EOS] — literally the conditional score_option measures — sha256 receipt, byte-rebuildable, val.bin filename contract of train.py, degenerate-pair skip; (3) frozen measured recipe configs/models/ryko-small-sft.yaml (model section identical to the test-pinned ryko-small.yaml; train section = the CPU recipe: 110 steps x (batch 1 x grad_accum 4) x block 512 = 225,280 tokens ~ 3.17 epochs of the 71,683-token packed stream, lr 3e-4 cosine, warmup 15, seed 1337; batch-1 decision MEASURED: batch 4 produces 268MB/copy vocab logits -> proven SIGKILL/OOM on a 3GB host, batch 1 + grad_accum 4 keeps identical tokens/step at ~1.2GB peak); (4) ACTUAL TRAINING EXECUTED: SFT 110 steps in ~10.5 min on 2 CPU cores at ~450-500 tok/s (train_loss 6.71 -> 4.23, val_loss 5.0615); DPO 396 steps on the 792 failure-probe pairs (beta 0.1, lr 1e-5) in ~9 min (loss 0.6931 -> 0.0, batch_acc 0 -> 1.0, final preference accuracy 0.9975, mean margin 164.19 — cost documented honestly: val PPL 165.5 -> 247.6, treatment noted for the GPU reset: higher beta / KL-budget); (5) full measured chain on RYKO-1000 base mode with one model-independent engine pass (cite 1.0 on 200, probes 1.0 on 857 materialized): random-init 52.18M floor MCQ 26.00% / over-refusal 1.00 -> SFT MCQ 39.86% (+13.86 over the measured random floor, +12.72 over the published v5c baseline 27.14%) / over-refusal 0.4062 -> DPO MCQ 39.86% / over-refusal 0.3750, correct-abstain 1.00 held at all three points; DPO behavior change measured (75/700 MCQ predictions + 3/100 abstain rows changed, net MCQ flat, refusal balance -3.12 points); reports docs/results/ryko1000_eval_small_{random,sft,dpo}.{json,md} + the delivery doc docs/results/ryko1000_small_training.md (incl. the measured CPU-work envelope: what is practical locally vs what stays GPU-bound); (6) verified checkpoint receipts for both new points artifacts/{sft,dpo}_ryko_small/ (99.53 MiB each, under the GitHub blob limit with margin) + logs/summaries/pack_manifest; (7) readiness card §4 rewritten (the GPU barrier fell for phases 5+9), ROADMAP phase-5/9 v1.20.0 status blocks, CHANGELOG, version 1.20.0; (8) .gitignore: resumable state (last.pt/best.pt/.bin) stays untracked — only final milestones + receipts are committed. 208 tests pass (200 + 8 new), secret_scan clean
